F24S.fTerm:
SOLAR HEAT COLLECTORS; SOLAR HEAT SYSTEMS (for producing mechanical power from solar energy F03G 6/00)[2018.01]

Note(s)

  • In this subclass, the following terms or expressions are used with the meanings indicated:[2018.01]
    • “solar heat collector modules”, often referred to simply as “modules”, covers:
      • whole solar heat collectors;
      • elements of solar heat collectors, e.g. reflectors, lenses or heat storage elements;
    • “absorbing elements” covers elements for absorbing solar rays and converting it into heat;
    • “solar heat systems” covers systems having solar heat collectors as their components and using the collected heat.
